text:
Predicates:
Contains(x, y) ::: x contains y.
Read(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
BecomesSmarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → Contains(x, knowledge)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y (Read(x, y) ∧ Book(y) → GainsKnowledge(x)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → BecomesSmarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Read(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
BecomesSmarter(harry) ::: Harry is smarter than before.
